name: composer
description: Builds a literature corpus that can be cited without checking it again. Harvests PubMed and, as a supplementary source, Google Scholar; downloads the Open Access full texts through the legitimate PMC OA / Europe PMC / Unpaywall routes, and admits a paper only when it (a) has a readable full text on disk and (b) survives 5-dimension bibliographic validation — DOI, first author, author list, journal and volume — cross-checked against Crossref, PubMed and Europe PMC, with a 2-of-3 majority rule so one publisher's malformed deposit cannot reject a real paper. Google Scholar contributes discovery only: every hit is resolved to a DOI and a PMID and the record is rebuilt from MEDLINE or Crossref, because a Scholar snippet carries nothing the gate can check — and its non-reproducibility and estimated hit count are stated in the search log. Every search gets its own directory with the exact query, the date, the true hit count and the gate result, logged to PRISMA 2020 / PRISMA-S and tied to a PROSPERO protocol record. Deterministic and LLM-free: retrieval and verification are mechanical, screening stays a human judgement.
